hooks.name: aidlc-sync-workflow-state
hooks.description: Keeps the workflow's Current Stage in aidlc-state.md in step with what has actually happened, so the status line and progress display stay accurate. Matched to shell tools across platforms: the IDE surfaces no task payload a sync could parse, so the hook derives the stage from the audit tail. The hook reads the bounded audit tail after each shell command and self-gates idempotently.
